
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/CreateMyself/p/20520236" title="发布于 2026-06-14 14:30">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">.NET Core自定义 ALC 中启动WebHost的HostingStartup解析异常</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">问题场景</span></h2>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">在 .NET Core插件系统中，插件程序集通过自定义 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>AssemblyLoadContext</code><span class="md-plain">（ALC）加载，与宿主程序的 Default ALC 保持隔离。当插件内部若需要自托管一个 Web 服务，调用 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>Host.CreateDefaultBuilder()</code><span class="md-plain"> 启动 WebHost 时，此时必然会出现一条致命异常：</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/589642/202606/589642-20260614133003250-488931149.png" alt="1" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">异常被捕获，但应用仍能正常运行，所以看起来只是一条日志污染，但它却出现 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>crit</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 级别，难免让我们心生疑惑。</span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">机制背景</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">HostingStartup 是什么</span></h3>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><span class="md-pair-s md-expand"><code>IHostingStartup</code><span class="md-plain"> 是 ASP.NET Core 提供的启动扩展点。标记 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>[assembly: HostingStartup]</code><span class="md-plain"> 特性的程序集，会在构建 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>IWebHostBuilder</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 时被自动加载并执行，允许外部组件在启动阶段注入服务和中间件，无需修改应用代码、也不需要应用显式依赖这些组件。这是 Azure 等 PaaS 平台实现零侵入集成的核心机制。典型场景：</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><strong>可观测性</strong> — <span style="font-size: 15px">Application Insights 通过 HostingStartup 自动注入请求追踪、依赖遥测、性能计数器，应用完全无感知</span></p>
<p><strong>平台集成</strong> — <span style="font-size: 15px">Azure AppService的AzureAppServices.HostingStartup注入诊断日志、应用预热（Application Initialization）、ARR 亲和性 Cookie 等平台级中间件</span></p>
<p><strong>配置增强</strong> — <span style="font-size: 15px">在 Configure()中读取远程配置中心数据，追加到 IWebHostBuilder，实现启动阶段的动态配置注入</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">程序集发现</span></h3>
<p><strong>配置指定</strong> — <span style="font-size: 15px">环境变量ASPNETCORE_HOSTINGSTARTUPASSEMBLIES，或配置键hostingStartupAssemblies</span></p>
<p><strong>自动扫描</strong> —<span style="font-size: 15px"> 遍历 deps.json 中列出的程序集，检查是否标记了 [assembly: HostingStartup]</span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">加载方式</span></h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">GenericWebHostBuilder.ExecuteHostingStartups()内部调用：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> assembly = Assembly.Load(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> AssemblyName(assemblyName));</pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px; color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">Assembly.Load(AssemblyName)仅在Default ALC中查找，对自定义 ALC 完全无感知。</span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">冲突链路</span></h2>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/589642/202606/589642-20260614135429977-1557375041.png" alt="image" loading="lazy"></p>
<h2><span class="md-plain md-expand">源码分析</span></h2>
<p><span class="md-pair-s md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><code>GenericWebHostBuilder.ExecuteHostingStartups()</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 的实际实现</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> ExecuteHostingStartups()
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> webHostOptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WebHostOptions(
        _config, Assembly.GetEntryAssembly()</span>?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.GetName().Name);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (webHostOptions.PreventHostingStartup)
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> exceptions = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> List&lt;Exception&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">();

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> assemblyNames =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> webHostOptions.HostingStartupAssemblies
        .Except(webHostOptions.HostingStartupExcludeAssemblies,
                StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
        .Distinct(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1) 先 Except(excludeAssemblies)，再 Distinct 去重
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2) 逐个程序集独立 try/catch，异常不中断循环</span>

    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> assemblyName <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> assemblyNames)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">try</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> assembly = Assembly.Load(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AssemblyName(assemblyName));
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">foreach</span> (<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> attr <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">in</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
                assembly.GetCustomAttributes</span>&lt;HostingStartupAttribute&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">())
            {
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> hostingStartup =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (IHostingStartup)Activator
                    .CreateInstance(attr.HostingStartupType);
                hostingStartup.Configure(_hostingStartupWebHostBuilder);
            }
        }
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> (Exception ex)
        {
            exceptions.Add(ex);  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 收集异常，继续处理后续程序集</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        }
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span> (exceptions.Count &gt; <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 128, 1)">0</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
        _hostingStartupErrors </span>=<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> exceptions;
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">每个程序集包裹在独立的 try/catch中，异常只影响当前程序集，循环继续执行后续程序集，不存在 StartupFilter 链断裂问题，</span><span style="font-size: 15px">Except(excludeAssemblies)在Assembly.Load()之前执行，被排除的程序集根本不会进入加载循环，这是解决方案生效的根基。</span><span style="font-size: 15px">所有异常最终存入 _hostingStartupErrors，由 GenericWebHostServiceOptions.HostingStartupExceptions对外暴露，日志组件据此输出crit级别日志。</span></p>
<h2><span class="md-plain md-expand">异常复现</span></h2>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">第一步：创建控制台宿主程序</span></h3>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><span class="md-plain md-expand">新建 .NET 控制台项目 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>ConsoleApp</code><span class="md-plain md-expand">。宿主需要两件事：启动WebHost，然后通过自定义 ALC 加载插件并调用其初始化方法。</span></span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Reflection;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> System.Runtime.Loader;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 1. 在 Default ALC 中启动第一个 WebHost</span>
Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[ConsoleApp] Starting first web host...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> mainHost =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Host.CreateDefaultBuilder(args)
    .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        webBuilder.UseUrls(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:5001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        webBuilder.Configure(app </span>=&gt; app.Run(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ctx =&gt;
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> ctx.Response.WriteAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello from main host!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)));
    })
    .Build();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mainHost.StartAsync();
Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[ConsoleApp] First host listening on http://localhost:5001</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 2. 通过自定义 ALC 加载插件程序集</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> pluginPath =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Path.Combine(
    AppContext.BaseDirectory, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Plugins</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TestLib.dll</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> alc = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomAssemblyLoadContext(pluginPath);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> asm =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> alc.LoadFromAssemblyPath(pluginPath);

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 验证隔离：TestLib 不在 Default ALC 中</span>
Console.WriteLine($<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[ConsoleApp] TestLib in Default ALC: </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span> +<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    $</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">{AssemblyLoadContext.Default.Assemblies.Any(a =&gt; a.GetName().Name == </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>TestLib<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">)}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 输出: False

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 3. 调用插件初始化方法</span>
asm.GetType(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TestLib.Initializer</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
   .GetMethod(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Initialize</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>)!<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
   .Invoke(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span>, <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Press ENTER to shut down...</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
Console.ReadLine();
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> mainHost.StopAsync();

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义 ALC：仅加载 Plugins 目录下的程序集，其余交给 Default ALC</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">internal</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">sealed</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> CustomAssemblyLoadContext : AssemblyLoadContext
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">private</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">readonly</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AssemblyDependencyResolver _resolver;

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> CustomAssemblyLoadContext(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">string</span> pluginDir) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">base</span>(isCollectible: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
    {
        _resolver </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AssemblyDependencyResolver(pluginDir);
    }

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">protected</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">override</span> Assembly?<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Load(AssemblyName assemblyName)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> path =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> _resolver.ResolveAssemblyToPath(assemblyName);
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> path <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">is</span> not <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span> ? LoadFromAssemblyPath(path) : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">确保 ConsoleApp.csproj中TestLib不作为项目引用。TestLib.dll 通过构建后事件拷贝到 Plugins/ 子目录，使其脱离 Default ALC 的探查路径：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Target </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Name</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="CopyTestLibToPlugins"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)"> AfterTargets</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="Build"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">MakeDir </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">Directories</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="$(OutputPath)Plugins"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Copy </span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">SourceFiles</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="..\TestLib\bin\$(Configuration)\net10.0\TestLib.dll"</span><span style="color: rgba(255, 0, 0, 1)">
          DestinationFolder</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">="$(OutputPath)Plugins"</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">/&gt;</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&lt;/</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Target</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">&gt;</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">第二步：创建测试插件类库</span></h3>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">新建 .NET 类库项目TestLib，引用Microsoft.AspNetCore.App框架。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Hosting;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Builder;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.AspNetCore.Http;
</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">using</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Microsoft.Extensions.Hosting;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 标记为 HostingStartup 程序集</span>
[assembly: HostingStartup(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TestLib.TestHostingStartup))]

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">namespace</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestLib;

</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> TestHostingStartup : IHostingStartup
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Configure(IWebHostBuilder builder)
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 观测点 1：记录 Configure 被调用，证明 TestLib 被成功加载为 HostingStartup</span>
        Console.WriteLine(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib.HostingStartup] Configure() invoked.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 观测点 2：检查当前程序集归属的 ALC</span>
        <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> currentAlc =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> AssemblyLoadContext.GetLoadContext(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">typeof</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(TestHostingStartup).Assembly);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib.HostingStartup] Loaded in ALC: {currentAlc?.Name ?? </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>Default<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        Console.WriteLine($</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib.HostingStartup] Is Default ALC: {currentAlc == AssemblyLoadContext.Default}</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 观测点 3：注册一个诊断中间件，验证 HostingStartup 注入是否生效</span>
        builder.Configure(app =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
        {
            app.Use(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> (ctx, next) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                ctx.Response.Headers[</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">X-HostingStartup</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>] = <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TestLib-Injected</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">;
                </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> next();
            });
        });

        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib.HostingStartup] Diagnostic middleware registered.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">TestHostingStartup本身也是一个观测手段——如果Configure()被调用，说明 ASP.NET Core 在 Default ALC 中成功定位并加载了 TestLib；反之，如果只有FileNotFoundException日志而Configure()从未触发，则证实了加载失败。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">class</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Initializer
{
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">public</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">static</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">void</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Initialize()
    {
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib] Called from custom ALC context.</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 模拟被注入到环境变量的场景</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">        Environment.SetEnvironmentVariable(
            </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">ASPNETCORE_HOSTINGSTARTUPASSEMBLIES</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span>, <span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">TestLib</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);

        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">var</span> host =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> Host.CreateDefaultBuilder()
            .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
            {
                webBuilder.UseUrls(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:5002</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
                webBuilder.Configure(app </span>=&gt; app.Run(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ctx =&gt;
                    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> ctx.Response.WriteAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello from inner host!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)));
            })
            .Build();

        host.Start();
        Console.WriteLine(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">[TestLib] Inner host started on http://localhost:5002</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
    }
}</span></pre>
</div>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">第三步：启动控制台程序</span></h3>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/589642/202606/589642-20260614133027131-996093317.png" alt="2" loading="lazy"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 15px">TestLib in Default ALC: False —— 插件确实只存在于自定义 ALC；</span><span style="font-size: 15px">异常来自GenericWebHostBuilder.ExecuteHostingStartups()→Assembly.Load()—— Default ALC 中找不到 TestLib</span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">解决方案</span></h2>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">在插件的 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>ConfigureWebHostDefaults</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 中，排除自身程序集：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">Host.CreateDefaultBuilder()
    .ConfigureWebHostDefaults(webBuilder </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    {
        </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 在 Assembly.Load 发生之前就排除 TestLib</span>
<span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">        webBuilder.UseSetting(
            WebHostDefaults.HostingStartupExcludeAssembliesKey,
            "TestLib"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"><span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">);</span>

        webBuilder.UseUrls(</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">http://localhost:5002</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">);
        webBuilder.Configure(app </span>=&gt; app.Run(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">async</span> ctx =&gt;
            <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">await</span> ctx.Response.WriteAsync(<span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">Hello from inner host!</span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">"</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)));
    })
    .Build();</span></pre>
</div>
<p class="md-end-block md-p md-focus"><span class="md-pair-s md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><code>WebHostOptions</code><span class="md-plain"> 在构建待加载列表时先执行 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>assemblies.Except(excludeAssemblies)</code><span class="md-plain">，再交给 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>ExecuteHostingStartups</code><span class="md-plain">。排除发生在 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>Assembly.Load()</code><span class="md-plain"> 之前，加载尝试根本不会触发。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h3 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">令人疑惑的API</span></h3>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">直觉上我们可能想直接清空 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>HostingStartupAssemblies</code><span class="md-plain md-expand">：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">webBuilder.UseSetting(
    WebHostDefaults.HostingStartupAssembliesKey, </span><span style="color: rgba(128, 0, 0, 1)">""</span>);  <span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 无效</span></pre>
</div>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px">但在 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>WebHostBuilder</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 内部，配置会按以下优先级合并：</span></span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">AddInMemoryCollection(_settings)     ←<span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)"> UseSetting 写入（低优先级）</span>
   .AddConfiguration(hostConfig)     ← <span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">环境变量在此（高优先级）</span></span></pre>
</div>
<p><span class="md-pair-s md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><code>_settings</code><span class="md-plain"> 中的空值被 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>hostConfig</code><span class="md-plain"> 中的环境变量覆盖，因此 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>UseSetting</code><span class="md-plain"> 无法清空由环境变量注入的值。而 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>HostingStartupExcludeAssemblies</code><span class="md-plain"> 没有对应的环境变量，<span class="md-pair-s"><code>UseSetting</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 写入的值不会被覆盖。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">总结</span></h2>
<p><span class="md-plain md-expand" style="font-size: 15px"><span class="md-plain md-expand"><span class="md-pair-s"><code>FileNotFoundException: Could not load file or assembly 'TestLib'</code><span class="md-plain">——<span class="md-pair-s">ASP.NET Core 尝试在 Default ALC 中加载 TestLib 作为 HostingStartup 程序集，但没找到<span class="md-plain">。这个失败的后果仅仅是一条 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>crit</code><span class="md-plain"> 日志，以及 <span class="md-pair-s"><code>IHostingStartup.Configure()</code><span class="md-plain md-expand"> 不会被调用。循环中的其他程序集不受影响，StartupFilter 链不受影响，WebHost 正常启动。换句话说：<span style="color: rgba(255, 102, 0, 1)">如果我们不依赖 Configure() 来做任何业务初始化，输出的致命异常日志对应用没有任何实质性影响。</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2 class="md-end-block md-heading md-focus"><span class="md-plain md-expand">参考链接</span></h2>

</div>
